description: Virtual machines for iOS and macOS

latest_release.name: v5.0.8
latest_release.body:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.8)
* Fixed several changes listed for v5.0.7 being left out of that build by mistake.
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Apple Silicon Macs without Rosetta by falling back to DXMT
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* ~~QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)~~ This was dropped and will be included in the next update.
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped

# UTM [![Build](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg?branch=main&event=push)][1] [![Mac App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mac_App_Store-UTM-0D96F6?logo=appstore&logoColor=white)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/utm-virtual-machines/id1538878817) [![App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App_Store-UTM_SE-0D96F6?logo=appstore&logoColor=white)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/utm-se-retro-pc-emulator/id1564628856) [![Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-UTM.dmg-24292F?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/releases/latest/download/UTM.dmg) > It is possible to invent a single machine which can be used to compute any computable sequence. -- Alan Turing, 1936 UTM is a full featured system emulator and virtual machine host for iOS, macOS, and visionOS. It is based off of QEMU. In short, it allows you to run Windows, Linux, and more on your Mac, iPhone, and iPad. More information at https://getutm.app/ and https://mac.getutm.app/


## Features * Full system emulation (MMU, devices, etc) using QEMU * 30+ processors supported including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V * VGA graphics mode using SPICE and QXL * Text terminal mode * USB devices * JIT based acceleration using QEMU TCG * Frontend designed from scratch for macOS 12+ and iOS 15+ using the latest and greatest APIs * Create, manage, run VMs directly from your device ## Additional macOS Features * Hardware accelerated virtualization using Hypervisor.framework and QEMU * Boot macOS guests with Virtualization.framework ## UTM SE UTM/QEMU requires dynamic code generation (JIT) for maximum performance. JIT on iOS devices require either a jailbroken device, or one of the various workarounds found for specific versions of iOS (see "Install" for more details). UTM SE ("slow edition") uses a [threaded interpreter][3] which performs better than a traditional interpreter but still slower than JIT. This technique is similar to what [iSH][4] does for dynamic execution. As a result, UTM SE does not require jailbreaking or any JIT workarounds and can be sideloaded as a regular app. To optimize for size and build times, only the following architectures are included in UTM SE: ARM, PPC, RISC-V, and x86 (all with both 32-bit and 64-bit variants). ## Install UTM (SE) for iOS: https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/ UTM is also available for macOS: https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/ ## Development ### [macOS Development](Documentation/MacDevelopment.md) ### [iOS Development](Documentation/iOSDevelopment.md) ## Related * [iSH][4]: emulates a usermode Linux terminal interface for running x86 Linux applications on iOS * [a-shell][5]: packages common Unix commands and utilities built natively for iOS and accessible through a terminal interface ## Lic

JIT on iOS devices require either a jailbroken device, or one of the various workarounds found for specific versions of iOS (see "Install" for more details). UTM SE ("slow edition") uses a [threaded interpreter][3] which performs better than a traditional interpreter but still slower than JIT. This technique is similar to what [iSH][4] does for dynamic execution. As a result, UTM SE does not require jailbreaking or any JIT workarounds and can be sideloaded as a regular app. To optimize for size and build times, only the following architectures are included in UTM SE: ARM, PPC, RISC-V, and x86 (all with both 32-bit and 64-bit variants). ## Install UTM (SE) for iOS: https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/ UTM is also available for macOS: https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/ ## Development ### [macOS Development](Documentation/MacDevelopment.md) ### [iOS Development](Documentation/iOSDevelopment.md) ## Related * [iSH][4]: emulates a usermode Linux terminal interface for running x86 Linux applications on iOS * [a-shell][5]: packages common Unix commands and utilities built natively for iOS and accessible through a terminal interface ## License UTM is distributed under the permissive Apache 2.0 license. # UTM [![Build](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg?branch=main&event=push)][1] [![Mac App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mac_App_Store-UTM-0D96F6?logo=appstore&logoColor=white)](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/utm-virtual-machines/id1538878817) [![App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App_Store-UTM_SE-0D96F6?logo=appstore&logoColor=white)](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/utm-se-retro-pc-emulator/id1564628856) [![Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-UTM.dmg-24292F?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/releases/latest/download/UTM.dmg) > 发明一台可用于计算任何可计算序列的机器是可行的。 -- 艾伦·图灵（Alan Turing），1936 年 UTM 是适用于 iOS、macOS 和 visionOS 的全功能系统模拟器和虚拟机主机。它基于 QEMU。简而言之，它允许你在 Mac、iPhone 和 iPad 上运行 Windows、Linux 等。有关更多信息，请访问 https://getutm.app/ 与 https://mac.getutm.app/


## 特色 * 使用 QEMU 的全系统模拟（MMU、设备等） * 支持 30+ 处理器，包括 x86_64、ARM64 和 RISC-V * 使用 SPICE 和 QXL 的 VGA 图形模式 * 文本终端模式 * USB 设备 * 使用 QEMU TCG 的基于 JIT 的加速 * 采用最新最好的 API，为 macOS 12+ 和 iOS 15+ 从头开始设计前端 * 直接从你的设备创建、管理与运行虚拟机 ## 其他 macOS 功能 * 使用 Hypervisor.framework 和 QEMU 的硬件加速虚拟化 * 使用 Virtualization.framework 启动 macOS 客户机 ## UTM SE UTM/QEMU 需要动态代码生成（JIT）才能获得最佳性能。iOS 设备上的 JIT 需要越狱设备，或为特定版本的 iOS 找到的各种变通方法之一（有关更多详细信息，请参阅“安装”）。 UTM SE（“较慢版”）使用[线程解释器][3]，其性能优于传统解释器，但仍然比 JIT 慢。此种技术与 [iSH][4] 用于动态执行的技术相似。因此，UTM SE 不需要越狱或任何 JIT 变通办法，且可以作为常规应用程序侧载。 为了优化大小和构建时间，UTM SE 中仅包含以下架构：ARM、PPC、RISC-V 和 x86（均有 32 位与 64 位变体）。 ## 安装 iOS 版 UTM (SE)：https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/ UTM 也可以在 macOS 上使用：https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/ ## 开发 ### [macOS 开发](Documentation/MacDevelopment.md) ### [iOS 开发](Documentation/iOSDevelopment.md) ## 相关项目 * [iSH][4]：模拟用户模式 Linux 终端接口，用于在 iOS 上运行 x86 Linux 应用程序 * [a-shell][5]：为 iOS 原生构建的通用 Unix 命令和实用程序，可通过终端接口访问 ## 许可 UTM 在宽容的 Apache 2.0 许可证分发。然而，它使用了若干 (L)GPL 组件。大多数组件为动态链接，但 gstreamer 插件是静态链接的，部分代码取自 QEMU。若要打算重新分发此应用程序，请注意这一点。 某些图标由 [Freepik](https://www.freepik.com) 从 [www.flaticon.com](https://www.flaticon.com/) 制作。 此外，UTM 前端依赖于以下 MIT/BSD 许可的组件： * [IQKeyboardManager](https://github.com/hackiftekhar/IQKeyboardManager) * [SwiftTerm](https://github.com/migueldeicaza/SwiftTerm) * [ZIP Foundation](https://github.com/weichsel/ZIPFoundation) * [InAppSettingsKit](https://github.com/futuretap/InAppSettingsKit) 持续集成托管由 [MacStadium](https://macstadium.com/company/opensource) 提供。 [](https://www.macstadium.com) [1]: https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/actions?query=event%3Arelease+workflow%3ABuild [2]: screen.png [3]: https://github.com/ktemkin/qemu/blob/with_tcti/tcg/aarch64-tcti/README.md [4]: https://github.com/ish-app/ish [5]: https://github.com/holzschu/a-shell
